name: HaalKhata
subtitle: Shared expenses, made simple
promotionalText: Snap the bill. Skip the typing. Scan receipts with AI, pick who had what, and split tax and tip. Free and open source. No ads, subscriptions, or paid features.
description:
Snap the bill. Skip the typing.

Great dinner. One receipt. Nobody wants to do the math.

HaalKhata makes shared expenses simple: scan the receipt with AI, pick who had what, and see everyone’s share, including tax and tip.

COMPLETELY FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
No ads, subscriptions, in-app purchases, or paid features. The full source code is public, so anyone can see how the app works and help improve it.

Source code: https://github.com/anirudha-ani/HaalKhata

LET AI DO THE TYPING
Take or choose a receipt photo. AI reads the items, tax, and tip; you review the details before saving. You can always enter a bill yourself.

PICK WHAT YOU HAD
Your meal, your share. Tap to assign items to the people who had them. Share an appetizer or dessert, and split tax and tip in proportion to each person’s items.

SPLIT TOGETHER
Open a live split and share the link. Friends join the same bill, claim their items, and save their part. Everyone can help, without passing one phone around.

FROM DINNER TO THE WEEKEND AWAY
Keep dinners, roommate bills, and trips organized in groups. Split equally, by exact amounts, percentages, shares, or individual items. Handle multiple payers and keep different currencies separate.

KNOW WHO OWES WHAT
See balances with friends and groups, follow comments and changes, and record a settlement after paying outside the app. Spending insights show where your share went. HaalKhata does not transfer money or process payments.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Sign in with Apple or Google. The layout adapts to your screen. Contacts access, AI receipt scanning, phone verification, and notifications are optional. Manage signed-in devices and delete your account in Account settings.

Shared expenses, made simple.

Privacy: https://haalkhata.app/privacy
Support: https://haalkhata.app/support
